title: apricity_analyze.voice and the apricity-analyze voice command
description: Calls `auritus.synthesize`; the id is `smp_`+sha256(request_key)[:20], so repeats are idempotent. Writes `files/audio/<id>/<name>.wav`, then reuses analyze and markup, seeding phrases from Auritus segments. Records the Sample (role generated, alias `voice/<name>.wav`). Supports `--from lines.yaml` for batches. Optional extra `apricity-analyze[voice]` pulls in `auritus[kokoro]`.
